name: Merz b. Schwanen
why: Tees, henleys and sweatshirts knitted on original loopwheel machines in Albstadt, Germany.
origin: Founded in 1911 by Balthasar Merz; revived in 2011 by Gitta and Peter Plotnicki, who restored the machines.

onething.n: verified — 100% organic cotton, 2-thread loopwheeled jersey at 245g, made in Albstadt, $120. The house has no 215-only collection, so the ORIGINALS page is linked; the 215 sits first on it

notes.cotton: 100 of 119 clothing styles are mainly cotton, and every German-made piece is jersey or fleece knit on loopwheelers or 1960s machines
notes.craft: Merz b. Schwanen runs its own loopwheeler floor in Albstadt (130 m², machines from 1889 to the 1960s) and its Originals and 2M15 pages say they are knitted there. But its about page says it has worked with a family-run Portuguese manufacturer since 2016, and sampled tees and thermals say 'Made in Portugal'. Owned making covers a core line, not the whole range: a 4.
notes.tech: nothing licensed and no elastane in any clothing style. The only stretch in the range is a swim lining and one sock
notes.briish: German end to end on the ORIGINALS side; the rest is made in Portugal
notes.dur: the German line is 2-thread and 2-thread heavy loopwheeled jersey at up to 245g, which is roughly double a standard tee
notes.whitet: Loopwheeled tees are the whole business.

craft_evidence.owned_d: Brand's 'Originals – Made in Germany' page: 'Still running in our German production site in Albstadt'; loopwheelers 'some over 100 years old … The newest machine was built in the 1960s, the oldest in 1889'; 'The machines live on a 130-square-metre floor'; founders restored the machines in 2011. Covers the ORIGINALS loopwheeled line and the 2M15 mid-century-machine jersey only. Other lines (TEE02, TEE03, thermals, tanks) come from 'a family-run manufacturer in Portugal' (partner since 2016, unnamed).
craft_evidence.countries: Rendered PDPs 4/4 state country: Germany 2/4 (215 loopwheeled tee, 2M15 tee), Portugal 2/4 (TEE02 tee, thermal henley). Product feed (21 records) carries no origin in description text, so origin lives in a separate PDP section; small sample, share of Germany vs Portugal across the full range unknown.
